generalCampusKnowledge.answer:
🎓 **PSG Tech Placements Overview:**
• Placement Rate: Over 90% of eligible students are placed annually across leading multinational firms.
• Top Recruiters: Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Caterpillar, Bosch, Qualcomm, Texas Instruments, Goldman Sachs, Cisco, Zoho, TCS, and L&T.
• Highest Package: ₹44+ LPA (International & Product Tier).
• Average Package: ₹8.5 - ₹12.5 LPA across Computing, Electrical, and Mechanical disciplines.
• Placement & Training Cell: Located on the Ground Floor, D-Block. For queries: placement@psgtech.ac.in.

🏛️ **Institutional Leadership:**
• Principal: Dr. K. Prakasan is the Principal of PSG College of Technology.
• Managing Trustee: Shri L. Gopalakrishnan, Managing Trustee of PSG & Sons' Charities Trust.
• Office of the Principal: Administrative Block, First Floor. Contact: principal@psgtech.edu / 0422-2572477.

📋 **Autonomous Attendance Regulations:**
• Minimum Attendance: A student must secure a minimum of **75% attendance** in each course to be permitted to sit for the Autonomous End-Semester Examinations.
• Condonation: Attendance between 65% and 74% can be condoned on valid medical grounds with appropriate medical certificates approved by the HoD and Principal.
• Below 65%: Students securing less than 65% are not eligible to write the end-semester exams for that course and must repeat the course in subsequent semesters.

📊 **Continuous Assessment (CA) System:**
• Weightage: 50 Marks for Continuous Assessment (CA) and 50 Marks for Autonomous End-Semester Examination.
• Continuous Assessment Tests (CAT): Conducted 3 times per semester (CAT-1, CAT-2, CAT-3).
• Components: Best 2 of 3 CATs + Assignments / Case Studies / Tutorial Assessments + Seminar Presentations.

📈 **Autonomous Grading & Credit System:**
• Grades: O (10 - Outstanding), A+ (9 - Excellent), A (8 - Very Good), B+ (7 - Good), B (6 - Average), C (5 - Satisfactory), RA (Re-Appearance / Arrear).
• GPA Formula: Σ(Course Credits × Grade Points) / Σ(Course Credits).
• Revaluation: Students can apply for photocopy of answer scripts and revaluation within 7 days of result publication via the COE portal.

📖 **Dr. G.R.D. Memorial Central Library:**
• Collection: Over 2,50,000+ volumes, 350+ printed national and international journals.
• E-Resources: Access to IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, ACM Digital Library, SpringerLink, and ASME.
• Working Hours: Monday to Saturday: 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Sundays: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM).
• Borrowing Limits: UG Students can borrow up to 6 books; PG Students up to 8 books for 14 days (renewable online).

🏠 **Hostel & Residential Life:**
• In-Time: Strictly **8:30 PM** (biometric punching mandatory at hostel turnstiles).
• Digital Outing Pass: Weekend home travel or late entries require pre-approved digital passes via the Form Filling Portal.
• Amenities: High-speed Wi-Fi, solar water heating, modernized steam kitchens, study halls, and laundry services.
• Chief Warden Office: 0422-4344777 / 4344444 (Peelamedu Hostel Office).

☕ **Dining & Cafeteria Facilities:**
• Central Canteen: Located near F-Block serving hygienic South Indian, North Indian, vegetarian, and non-vegetarian meals and snacks.
• Timings: 7:30 AM to 7:00 PM on all working days.
• Additional Spots: Campus Cafe, Fruit Juice Corner, and Coffee kiosks near the Library and Mechanical block.

🎉 **Campus Life & Student Clubs:**
• KRIYA: The landmark annual global techno-management festival organized by the Students Union of PSG Tech.
• Technical Clubs: IEEE Student Branch, ACM Chapter, Computer Society of India (CSI), SAE Collegiate Club, Robotics Club, Coding Club.
• Cultural & Social Clubs: Rotaract Club of PSG Tech, NSS, NCC (Air & Army Wings), Dramatics Club, Fine Arts Club, Music Club, Book Readers Club.

💰 **Scholarships & Financial Assistance:**
• Government Schemes: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/SCC, BC/MBC/DNC welfare scholarships, First Graduate Tuition Fee Concession.
• National Scholarships: Central Sector Scheme (NSP portal), Pragati Scholarship for Girls (AICTE).
• Institutional Aid: PSG & Sons' Charities Merit-cum-Means Scholarships and PSG Tech Alumni Association (Laudea) Trust awards.
• Helpdesk: Academic Section, Main Admin Block.

👔 **Campus Discipline & Dress Code:**
• ID Card: Students must wear their official RFID Identity Card visibly with lanyard at all times inside campus.
• Dress Code: Formal/smart-casual attire. For laboratory sessions, students must wear approved protective workshop coats and closed-toe leather/canvas shoes.
• Mobile Phones: Mobile phone usage during lecture and lab hours is strictly restricted unless instructed for academic tasks.

🎓 **Departments & Academic Programmes:**
• Computing: Computer Science & Engg (CSE), Information Technology (IT), Computer Applications (MCA), AI & Data Science.
• Electrical: Electrical & Electronics (EEE), Electronics & Communication (ECE), Instrumentation & Control (ICE), Biomedical Engg.
• Mechanical & Sciences: Mechanical Engg, Production, Metallurgy, Robotics & Automation, Civil Engg, Biotechnology, Applied Science, MBA.
• Syllabi for all courses are available in the Academics Portal.

🚌 **Transportation & Location Connectivity:**
• Campus Location: Avinashi Road, Peelamedu, Coimbatore - 641004.
• From Airport (CJB): Just 4 km away (~10 mins by taxi or city bus).
• From Railway Station (CBE): Approx. 7 km. City bus routes: 20A, 70, 11 operate frequently directly to the PSG Tech bus stop.
• College Buses: College operates dedicated transportation routes across Coimbatore, Tirupur, and Pollachi for day scholars.

🏥 **Campus Amenities & Healthcare:**
• Banking & ATM: Full-fledged Indian Bank branch with 24/7 ATM on campus; additional SBI ATM near the hostel gate.
• Health Centre: On-campus medical dispensary with resident doctors, nursing staff, and 24/7 emergency ambulance service.
• Sports & Fitness: Synthetic basketball court, floodlit volleyball court, football ground, indoor badminton stadium, and modernized gymnasium (Open: 6:00 AM - 8:00 AM & 4:30 PM - 7:00 PM).

📄 **Bonafide Certificate Procedure:**
• You can apply online instantly through our **Form Filling Portal**.
• Select the purpose: Bank Education Loan, Passport Application, Bus/Train Concession, or State Scholarship.
• Once submitted, the application is e-verified by your HoD and issued within 2 working days.

🎫 **Autonomous Examination & Hall Ticket:**
• End-Semester Hall Tickets are published through the COE portal 1 week prior to exams.
• Duplicate hall ticket requisition or correction can be filed through the Online Forms Portal.

💳 **Fee Payment Guidelines:**
• Semester tuition and hostel fees can be paid via the official PSG Tech Online Fee Portal (Net Banking / Debit Card / UPI).
• Offline Payment: Can be made using Challan at Indian Bank, Peelamedu Branch (Campus premises).
• Details & fee breakdowns are available on the Admissions & Fees page.

📶 **Campus Wi-Fi & IT Infrastructure:**
• Network: High-speed campus-wide 10 Gbps optical fiber backbone network.
• Access: Students can register their laptops and devices at the Computer Centre (CC) to receive individual Wi-Fi authentication credentials.
• Studzone: Access attendance, marks, and course registration using your student roll number credentials.

student.answer: As per Autonomous regulations, minimum required attendance is 75% per course to appear for Autonomous End-Semester Examinations. Students between 65%-74% must apply for condonation under medical grounds.
Continuous Assessment (CA) carries 50 marks for theory courses based on 3 Continuous Assessment Tests (CATs), assignments, and tutorial seminars.
Hostel in-time is strictly 8:30 PM (biometric verification). Late gate entry requires pre-approved digital outing slips generated through the hostel form portal.
You can request a Bonafide Certificate online via the Form Filling portal. After approval by the HoD, it will be issued within 2 working days.

faculty.answer: Faculty members can file Casual Leave (CL), On-Duty (OD) permissions, and Compensatory Offs via the Staff Self-Service section on the Forms Portal.
Academic Council & Departmental Staff meeting minutes are available under the Faculty Intranet portal archives.
Board of Studies (BOS) syllabus revision proposals can be submitted to the Academic Council coordinator before November 15.

parent.answer: Semester tuition and hostel fees can be paid through the official PSG Tech payment gateway via Net Banking, UPI, or Challan at Indian Bank, Peelamedu branch.
Chief Warden Office: 0422-4344777 (Hostel Office). Visiting hours for parents are between 4:00 PM and 6:30 PM on weekends.
Student semester grade sheets and attendance logs are updated on the Parent Portal using the student roll number and registered parent mobile OTP.

visitor.answer: B.E./B.Tech admissions are conducted through TNEA counselling based on 12th standard cutoffs. M.E./M.Tech/MCA/MBA are via TANCET / GATE counselling.
